name: oberon
description: Claude Code plugins from alxjrvs. A registry, not a library — every plugin here is sourced from the repository that already uses it in anger.

plugins.name: agent-friendly-repo
plugins.description: Configure a GitHub repo so the agent completion path — commit, push, PR, auto-merge — actually lands: squash-only merges, a branch-protection ruleset that keeps CI required without a human review gate agents cannot satisfy, stacked PRs, and optional Dependabot auto-merge or a merge queue.

plugins.name: chezmoi-change
plugins.description: The worktree → apply → PR ritual for a chezmoi dotfiles repo: the source checkout stays on main, a change is made in a worktree and applied from there with --source "$PWD", and the four traps that each cost a day — --init with --source, a source checkout left on a branch, a deleted source that never deletes its target, and a run script that cannot call chezmoi — are stated rather than rediscovered.

plugins.name: 1password-mcp
plugins.description: The 1Password desktop app's own MCP server, by absolute path: the desktop app does not always hand a spawned server the login PATH. Needs the app installed with its MCP server enabled; then installing this plugin is the whole setup, and nothing is written to ~/.claude.json.
